session.worktreeNote: own working copy (git worktree), cleaned up if unused

stats.tooltip: Output and fresh input are newly processed. Cache writes cost extra, cache reads are cheap and are reported again on every request.

roleRun.noRoleAlert: This round ran without a role — no review performed. The role run catches up without asking the orchestrator.
roleRun.briefingTitle: Fills the task with a template: goal, scope, files, expected result — never just "review this".
roleRun.briefingText:
Goal: 
Scope (only … / explicitly not …): 
Relevant files: 
Expected result (format):
roleRun.attachStateTitle: The working state is collected once and given to all roles, instead of each gathering it themselves
roleRun.emptyTaskNote: Empty task = review of the uncommitted state. Any other text goes to each role verbatim.
roleRun.title: Role run
roleRun.subtitle: each role as its own session — independent of the orchestrator
roleRun.noRoleError: No role selected for the role run.
roleRun.modelSelectTitle: "per role" omits --model — the model: from the role file applies

waitState.waitingFor: Response is ready — the session has been waiting for your reply since {time}.

hooks.title: Hooks & Automation
hooks.subtitle: Triggers, night runs, and delivery
hooks.gateDescription: Stop hook: runs after every session with uncommitted changes to security-relevant files.
hooks.saved: settings.json written (backup placed next to it).
hooks.hooksActive: {count, plural, one {# hook active} other {# hooks active}}

sidebar.roleLocked: "{role}" was given to this session and can no longer be removed
sidebar.roleAdd: Add "{role}" now — the session gets a task for it
sidebar.lockNote: Roles can be added but not removed. Model and auto-permissions live in the process invocation — they switch via Apply, the conversation continues through --resume. The project folder is fixed.
sidebar.messagesHint: Further instructions go to the running session at the bottom right.
sidebar.cliMismatch: This is the running invocation. The selection above differs from it.
sidebar.hookCardNote: Runs automatically after sessions with code changes
sidebar.promptHint: Full specification upfront — name every sub-requirement here. Drip-feeding details costs quality and rounds.
